## Zephyr v1.1.8

Bigger marketplace, fuller AI model list, clearer update notes.

### Language marketplace (101 languages)

Every language pack is now in the Marketplace with its **real logo** (not colored initials):

| Language | Logo | Color |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Python | Simple Icons | #3776ab |
| Rust | Simple Icons | #dea584 |
| Go | Simple Icons | #00add8 |
| JavaScript | Simple Icons | #f7df1e |
| C/C++ | VS Code Icons | #659ad2 |
| Java/Java (clike) | VS Code Icons | #659ad2 |
| PowerShell | Devicon | #012456 |
| SQL | Devicon | #e38c00 |

101 language packs + 5 starter extensions = 106 in the Marketplace. All install and enable without errors.

### Full AI model catalog

The AI catalog now runs from each provider's earliest models to its latest:

| Provider | Models | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Google Gemini | 3.8 Flash, 3.7 Flash, 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash(-Lite), 3.1 Pro/Flash-Lite, 2.5 Pro/Flash(-Lite), 2.5 image, 2.0, 1.5, 1.0 | complete |
| OpenAI | GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, GPT-5.2, 5.1 mini, o4-mini, o3, o1, GPT-5, GPT-4.1, 4o, 4, 3.5 | complete |
| Anthropic | Claude Fable 5.1/5, Opus 5/4.8, Sonnet 5/4.5, Haiku 4.5, 3.7, 3.5, 3, 2.1, 2, 1 | complete |
| DeepSeek | V4 Pro, Flash (V4.1), Chat (V3.2), Reasoner (R1), Coder, V3 | complete |

### Custom / local AI, easier

Using your own model (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI-compatible, etc.) is simpler now:

- **Settings → Model AI → pick "Lokal (opencode / loopback)" or "Custom"**.
- Fill in the **base URL** (for Ollama: `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`), then type the **model name** in the field. There is now a **dropdown button** to pick from the catalog list plus the API list (the **Refresh** button pulls models straight from the provider).
- It shows up in the **AI panel (bottom left), not just the AI terminal**. The AI panel dropdown lists the custom model you set, with logo and key status. A "how to use" hint sits right on the Settings page.

### Donations

Zephyr is free and stays free. If you like it, there is a **donate button** in the **bottom status bar** (right side) and in **Settings → About**. It opens Saweria (`saweria.co/ShinRyuga04`). You can also go through **Help → Donasi** or press `Ctrl+Shift+P` and type "donasi". Every tip is appreciated.

### Fixes and more

- Update notifications and the "What's new" dialog now render the **changelog table** (not plain text).
- Zephyr-style update dialog: bigger, changelog visible at once, **View on GitHub** button.
- Type fixes and model catalog cleanup.

How to update: open Settings → About → Check update, or wait for the bell.
